_note: This file is auto-updated by fetch_openrouter.py --parameters. The _fetched_at field is set on fetch.

temperature.description: Influences the variety in the model's responses. Lower values lead to more predictable responses, higher values encourage more diverse and creative output.

top_p.description: Restricts choices to tokens whose cumulative probability equals P. Functions as dynamic top-k, adapting token selection based on probability distribution.

top_k.description: Constrains token selection to a smaller set at each generation step. Limits sampling to the k most likely tokens.

frequency_penalty.description: Controls token repetition based on input frequency. Penalty scales with the number of times a token has appeared. Positive values discourage repetition.

presence_penalty.description: Adjusts how often the model repeats specific tokens already used in the input. Unlike frequency_penalty, applies a flat penalty regardless of occurrence count.

repetition_penalty.description: Reduces token repetition. Penalty scales by original token probability. Values > 1.0 discourage repetition; < 1.0 encourage it.

min_p.description: Minimum probability threshold relative to the most likely token. Tokens below min_p * P(most_likely) are filtered out.

top_a.description: Filters tokens based on probability proximity to the highest-probability option. More aggressive filtering than top_p for focused outputs.

seed.description: Enables deterministic sampling for reproducible outputs. When set, the model attempts to return the same output for repeated requests with the same seed.

max_tokens.description: Upper limit on generated tokens. Cannot exceed context length minus prompt length. If not set, model generates until natural stop or context limit.

logit_bias.description: Adjusts token selection likelihood via token ID mappings. Positive values increase likelihood, negative values decrease it. -100 effectively bans a token.

logprobs.description: Returns log probabilities of output tokens. Useful for analyzing model confidence in its predictions.

top_logprobs.description: Number of most likely tokens with probabilities returned per position. Requires logprobs=true.

response_format.description: Specifies output format. Set {"type": "json_object"} to enforce valid JSON output. Model will only produce syntactically valid JSON.

structured_outputs.description: Enables structured outputs using JSON schema. When true, the model follows the provided JSON schema in response_format to produce typed, validated output.

stop.description: Halts generation upon encountering any of the specified token sequences. Useful for controlling where the model stops generating.

tools.description: Tool/function calling parameter following OpenAI's format. Defines functions the model can invoke. Each tool has a name, description, and JSON schema for parameters.

tool_choice.description: Controls tool invocation behavior. 'none' disables tools, 'auto' lets model decide, 'required' forces a tool call, or specify a particular tool.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Enables simultaneous vs sequential function calls. When true, the model may invoke multiple tools in a single response.

verbosity.description: Constrains response detail level. Lower values produce more concise responses, higher values produce more detailed ones.

reasoning.description: Unified parameter for controlling AI model reasoning (thinking) behavior. Contains sub-fields: effort, max_tokens, exclude, enabled.

effort.description: Allocates reasoning tokens as approximate percentages of max_tokens. xhigh=~95%, high=~80%, medium=~50%, low=~20%, minimal=~10%, none=disabled. Supported by OpenAI (o1, o3, GPT-5) and Grok models.

max_tokens.description: Direct maximum token allocation for reasoning. Minimum 1024 for Anthropic models, capped at 128000. Supported by Gemini thinking, Anthropic, and some Qwen models.

exclude.description: When true, model uses reasoning internally but withholds it from response output.

enabled.description: Enables reasoning with medium effort and no exclusions when set to true. Inferred from effort/max_tokens if not set.

include_reasoning.description: Legacy parameter. true is equivalent to {"reasoning": {}}. false is equivalent to {"reasoning": {"exclude": true}}. Use the unified 'reasoning' parameter instead.

reasoning_effort.description: Legacy shorthand for reasoning.effort. Controls thinking time. Budget formula: max(min(max_tokens * effort_ratio, 128000), 1024). Use the unified 'reasoning' parameter instead.

web_search_options.description: Configures web search for grounding model responses with real-time data. Can also be activated by appending ':online' to the model slug. Powered natively for Anthropic, OpenAI, Perplexity, xAI; uses Exa for other models.

search_context_size.description: Determines the volume of search data retrieved and processed. low=minimal for basic queries, medium=moderate for general queries, high=extensive for detailed research.
